Clip Shrinker - third-party components
======================================

ClipShrinker itself is MIT licensed (see LICENSE.txt). It uses these components, each under its own licence:

- ffmpeg / ffprobe (LGPL build) - see ffmpeg-LICENSE.txt
- Khronos OpenCL ICD loader (built into ffmpeg.exe, for the GPU denoise of Picture adjustments) - Apache 2.0,
  Copyright (c) The Khronos Group Inc., see OpenCL-ICD-Loader-LICENSE.txt (https://github.com/KhronosGroup/OpenCL-ICD-Loader)
- AMD AMF headers (built into ffmpeg.exe, for AMD graphics encoding) - MIT, Copyright (c) Advanced Micro Devices,
  Inc., see AMF-LICENSE.txt (https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AMF)
- Intel oneVPL dispatcher (built into ffmpeg.exe, for Intel Quick Sync encoding) - MIT, Copyright (c) Intel
  Corporation, see oneVPL-LICENSE.txt (https://github.com/intel/libvpl)
- whisper.cpp and ggml (DLLs next to the AI editing module's ffmpeg.exe in modules\ai-agent\ffmpeg, downloaded
  with the module; speech to text, on the graphics card through Vulkan or on the CPU; the Vulkan backend is
  built with the Khronos Vulkan headers, Apache 2.0, and uses the graphics driver's vulkan-1.dll) - MIT, Copyright (c) The ggml authors, see whisper.cpp-LICENSE.txt there
  (https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp). The speech models it downloads
  when needed: OpenAI Whisper large-v3-turbo (MIT, https://github.com/openai/whisper) and Silero VAD (MIT,
  https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad), in the ggml format from huggingface.co.
- RIFE ncnn Vulkan (smooth slow motion, in modules\timeline-effects\rife) - MIT, see its LICENSE.txt
- .NET runtime and WPF (built into ClipShrinker.exe) - MIT, Copyright (c) .NET Foundation and Contributors
  (https://github.com/dotnet/runtime, https://github.com/dotnet/wpf)
- CommunityToolkit.Mvvm - MIT, Copyright (c) .NET Foundation and Contributors
  (https://github.com/CommunityToolkit/dotnet)
